name: Hashiba Hideyoshi
source:
A good natured, cheerful and reliable, "swindler".
A retainer who has pledged allegiance to Nobunaga.
His natural ability is his cleverness and mainly his devotion.
He's famous for liking women and he's always trying to poke into Hotaru's business somehow or another.
